notes:
**Your daily loss limit was measured on whatever ticked in the last packet.** A broker socket sends a third of a second of movement, not your whole book. The limit measured only the positions in that one packet and compared the result to your whole-account cap - so a loss split across two positions never reached the limit, because the two halves were never in the same packet. An equity position not on a watchlist was in no packet at all.

**And when the cap did break, the square-off closed only what had just ticked** - then blocked itself from trying again for the rest of the day, while the notification said everything was closed and the Risk screen promised "closes every open position at market". It measures and closes against the whole book now. Anything it genuinely cannot price is left open and counted out loud, rather than claimed.

**Pay Later could go short.** You cannot borrow a share you do not own, and the engine has a message saying exactly that - which was unreachable code. Selling to close an MTF long still works.

**A support log never carried the error being reported** - it was sending the first fifty lines of app startup instead of the last fifty.

**On Upstox the chart's time axis was five and a half hours early**, and indicator alerts were running on a series where every overlapping candle appeared twice.
